title: Nine Winters and One Short Step
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：entrance　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 entrance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1908 my grandmother ① gained an entrance that no porter in the hall would have allowed, and she said the gaining was the whole of the winter. The ② entrance, meaning the door itself and not the exit, ran nine winters and stayed unallowed in the book; an entrance, she said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left unallowed.

Every ③ entrance in that hall had the same short step beside it, and the ④ entrance at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the guests and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An entrance, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to allow; my grandmother said the allowing is the part that fills nine winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the entrance was the whole of the ceremony, meaning the coming in and not the door. The ⑥ entrance, meaning the coming in and not any of that, is the only thing in a ceremony that everybody waits for and nobody allows; entrance, he said, is either something you gain or the only word that means both a door and a coming in. He said the coming in is the part they remember.

By 1916 the ⑦ entrance had become a line in a drawing, and the drawing had become an argument about the short step. The ⑧ entrance of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one hall and nine winters of allowing; entrance, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to allow. She said the allowing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ entrance I remember is the one allowed in the drawing, which closed in 1921 and is still described as the quietest in the hall. An ⑩ entrance, my mother said in 1923, is the only one that improves by being allowed; every entrance, she said, is a coming in that has agreed to look like a door. She said the coming in was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。

answers.why: gain an entrance 意为“获准进入”，1908 年祖母获准从一处大厅里没有一位门房肯放行的入口进去。
entrance 意为“入口”，指那一处本身而不是出口，它经过了九个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
entrance 意为“入口”，指大厅里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一级短短的台阶。
entrance 意为“入口”，指留给宾客的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
entrance 意为“进入、入场”，指典礼上人人都等却无人记下的那样东西，叔叔说这次入场就是那个典礼的全部。
entrance 意为“进入”，指人人都等却无人记下的那种许可而不是那一处门，是典礼上人人都等、却无人记下的东西。
entrance 意为“入口”，指图样上写到、被标出的那一处，到 1916 年这一处成了图样里的一行。
entrance 意为“入口”，祖母一月写道，整件事的进门之事是一座大厅和九个冬天的放行。
entrance 意为“入口”，我记得的是图样上标出的那一处，1921 年关了，至今仍被说成大厅里最安静的一处。
entrance 为抽象总称，母亲 1923 年说，一处入口是唯一会因为被好好放行而变得更好的东西。
